description: Slice any photo into an N×M tile puzzle: preview the numbered grid, download all tiles as a ZIP or a contact sheet.

faqs.a: Tiles are cut from your photo at full resolution and zipped as puzzle-r1-c1.png style files, numbered in the preview so you know the order.
faqs.q: How are the tiles named and ordered?

faqs.a: Up to 8 × 8 (64 tiles). The preview shows every tile numbered.
faqs.q: How many tiles can I make?

faqs.a: Yes — slicing happens on a canvas in your browser; the photo is never uploaded.

howto: Set rows and columns with the sliders — the numbered preview updates live.
Click "Download tiles (ZIP)" for individual pieces, or "Download contact sheet" for one overview PNG.
Reassemble, print, or share your puzzle!
title: Puzzle Maker
